headline: Record revenue, earnings and client asset inflows
summary_short: Schwab's Q3 2026 net revenues were a record $7.17B (+17% y/y) and GAAP EPS a record $1.62 (+29%); core net new assets were $190.4B.
summary_long: Asset management and administration fees grew 14% to $1.9B, trading revenue rose 16% to $1.2B and net interest margin expanded q/q to 3.04%. Clients opened 1.2M new brokerage accounts, bringing the total to 48.6M. Margin loans rose 14% q/q to $187.9B and bank loans were up 35% y/y. GAAP expenses rose 9%. Pre-tax margin was 52.7%, and return on tangible common equity was 44%. Schwab repurchased 4.7M shares for $0.5B. The release gives no numeric guidance.
confidence_notes: Adjusted figures exclude $151 million of pre-tax acquisition and integration-related costs and amortization of acquired intangibles. Pre-tax margin change computed from 52.7% versus 49.2%.

drivers.explanation: Deeper client engagement broadened the revenue model: asset management fees grew 14% and trading revenue 16%, with net interest margin widening.
Clients opened 1.2 million new brokerage accounts; Schwab Wealth Advisory net flows rose 55% and Managed Investing Solutions flows 22%.
CFO credited a diversified business model, focus on clients' evolving needs and industry-leading scale.
